name: alphabet-match
description: A letter-matching game for preschoolers, wrapped for iOS and Android.

scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www/voice && cp index.html voice-player.js www/ && rsync -a --exclude='.*' voice/ www/voice/
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
